mentions.name: Tmux-cli
mentions.description: A tool and skill that enable CLI agents to interact with scripts, including other agents, running in other Tmux panes — like Playwright for the terminal. Multiple CLI agents can collaborate or consult with each other, and an agent can run and interact with interactive CLI scripts.
mentions.audience: Users of Claude Code, Codex CLI and similar CLI coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt: Tmux-cli tool + skill to enable CLI agents to interact with scripts (including other agents) running in other Tmux panes. Like Playwright for the terminal. Multiple CLI agents can collaborate/consult etc. Agent can run and interact with interactive CLI scripts.
